info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Saves-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Save Retrieval API enables businesses to access saved cart information from users. This API supports operations for retrieving a list of saved carts, facilitating better insights into customer preferences and shopping behaviors. Typical consumers of this API include ecommerce platforms and analytics services interested in enhancing user experience and optimizing marketing strategies. The endpoint provides a seamless way to understand saved items and abandoned carts, allowing for improved engagement and personalized offers.

get.summary: Retrieve the current state of the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the latest items present in the user's shopping cart. It can be used to display the cart contents to the user or for analytics purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to save cart details. It is expected to include the cart's items and any relevant user information to ensure that the correct data is stored.
